rng_mode: official_global; seeded before benchmark import and environment construction; no env.seed
renderer: CPU OSMesa llvmpipe; shared standard runtime library
language: exact perturbed task.language; full prompt cache key
action: native EEF10 to LIBERO OSC7; same adapter as standard
prerequisite: User directly authorized Plus after completed32GPU training; actual_node_exit_codes=[0,0,0,0]
summary_metrics: macro mean of seven category success rates
difficulty_unlabeled_policy: Retain and evaluate all121; separate unlabeled stratum in difficulty breakdown, include in overall/category/suite metrics
text_encoder: Live frozen native T5, exact perturbed full prompt; training40-prompt diskcache disabled; bounded prompt LRU allowed
reset: Upstream default hard reset; fresh process and environment per variant; first provided initial state
comparability: 10030 official variants and one trial match upstream. seed10000/settle30/600,600,600,700 are OpenWAM author settings, not universal LIBERO-Plus requirements. Other model runners use different seeds, settle and limits; no claim of bit-identical reproduction or fair ranking without protocol alignment.
infrastructure_failures: Do not count as task failures; preserve error and retry the same task, completed normal failures are not retried
deployment_adapter: Exact training RoutedMutualMoTDriver; full strict load then V2 physical prune
